SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.______

REPORT
Bubbling Well Station,
Date January 31, 19 31

Subject (in full) Report on work of C.D.S. 10 Kyung Yang Ngoo.

Made by ______ and Forwarded by D.S.I. MacFarlane

Sir,
With reference to the above mentioned detective, I beg
to state that since his transfer to this Station on the 1st. December
at/
1930 he has all times being diligent and conscientious about his work.
On several occasions while working under the personal observation
of the undersigned the C.D.S. mentioned carried out the enquiries in
a thorough manner. No complaint or adverse report has been received
regarding him from any of the other Foreign Detectives attached to
this Station.

In connection with a recent armed robbery which occurred
in this District (C.R. 930) wherein property to the value of $4965.00
was stolen C.D.S. 10 was instrumental in arresting 6 persons, four of
whom were convicted and property to the value of $2749.00 was recover
-ed.

D.S.I.

D.D.O. "B" Division.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号______

报告
静安寺捕房，
日期 1931年1月31日

主题（全称）关于刑事侦缉警长10号 Kyung Yang Ngoo 工作的报告。

由 ______ 制作，经警司 MacFarlane 转发

先生，
关于上述侦探，谨陈述如下：自1930年12月1日调至本捕房以来，他工作始终勤勉尽责。在署名人亲自观察下的几次工作中，上述刑事侦缉警长以彻底的方式进行了调查。本捕房所属的其他外籍侦探均未收到关于他的任何投诉或负面报告。

在本区最近发生的一起武装抢劫案（C.R. 930）中，被盗财物价值4965.00美元，刑事侦缉警长10号在逮捕6名嫌疑人方面发挥了重要作用，其中4人被定罪，并追回价值2749.00美元的财物。

警司

D.D.O. “B”分区。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ______
SINZA Station,
REPORT
Date January 30, 1931.

Subject (in full) Report on work performed by C.D.S.I. Loh Kung Sung.

Made by D.S.I. White. Forwarded by ____________________

Sir;
During the period which C.D.S.I. Loh Kung Sung has been attached to Sinza Station, namely December 1930 and January 1931, he has conducted his part in charge of the Chinese detective staff in a very capable manner. The already named detective has a very good knowledge of the duties in general which are expected of him, namely investigation of crime and the administration of work in general among the whole staff. C.D.S.I. Loh Kung Sung is himself a constant and energetic worker, he takes a keen interest in all duties and ever ready to advise or assist men junior to him. With full co-operation from the whole staff he would be a very capable leader.

C. White.
D.S.I.

报告

主题（全称）关于刑事侦缉副督察 Loh Kung Sung 所执行工作的报告。

由警司 White 制作。由 ____________________ 转发

先生；
在刑事侦缉副督察 Loh Kung Sung 隶属于新闸捕房期间，即1930年12月和1931年1月，他在负责华籍侦探团队方面表现得非常能干。前述侦探对他被期望承担的一般职责，即犯罪调查和整个团队的日常行政管理，有着很好的了解。刑事侦缉副督察 Loh Kung Sung 本人工作持之以恒且充满活力，他对所有职责都抱有浓厚兴趣，并随时准备向资历较浅的同僚提供建议或协助。若能得到全体员工的充分合作，他将成为一位非常能干的领导者。

C. White.
警司。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
"D" Div: Det: Officer,
Wayside Station,
REPORT
Date January 30th, 1931.
File No.

Subject (in full) Report re attached.

Made by Det: Supt: Quayle. Forwarded by

Sir :

With reference to the attached I beg to forward the
following reports on the work of C.D.S.I. Yang Ah Zien, C.D.S.
123 Ma Siau Ts and C.D.C. 135 Wong Z Toong, all of whom are
attached to Yangtszepco Station.

The work of C.D.S.I. Yang Ah Zien has been satisfactory
inasmuch as he has visited the Station frequently and helped in
the cases on which other detectives were working. He has shown
no initiative in obtaining cases himself.

From enquiries amongst the Foreign Detectives at
Yangtszepoo Station C.D.S. 123 Ma Siau Ts does not appear to have
been much use to the staff of the Station since his transfer there.
He has shown a lack of interest in the cases on which he has been
engaged and on my instructions was made a defaulter for failing
to carry out important orders, i.e. amongst other things, for
failing to be present at the Station to proceed on a raid for
armed robbers when ordered to do so. As a result D.O. "D" has
forwarded a recommendation that he be reduced to Constable and
reverted to uniform.

I am unable to report that the work of C.D.C. 135 Wong Z
Toong has been satisfactory since his transfer to Yangtszepoo
Station. He has obtained no cases since he came to the Station
and his conduct in a recent armed robbery case was so suspicious
that it is now the subject of investigation.

Yours obediently,
[Signature]
Div: Det: Officer,
"D" Division.

D. O.
("D" Division).

（批：T. C. Givis!
Forwarded; please whether I shall do
It is doubtful whether any disciplinary action can be taken
will be possible against C.D.C. 135 in which case that he be
probably recommended to uniform branch.
Acting Divl.
Divisional Officer ("D") Division
JAN. 1931）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
“D”分区：侦探官，
路边捕房，
报告
日期 1931年1月30日。
档案号

主题（全称）关于附件的报告。

由侦探总监 Quayle 制作。由 转发

先生：

关于附件，谨呈报以下关于刑事侦缉副督察 Yang Ah Zien、刑事侦缉警长123号 Ma Siau Ts 和刑事侦缉警员135号 Wong Z Toong 工作的报告，此三人均隶属于杨树浦捕房。

刑事侦缉副督察 Yang Ah Zien 的工作令人满意，因为他经常访问捕房，并协助其他侦探正在处理的案件。但他自己在获取案件方面未表现出主动性。

经向杨树浦捕房的外籍侦探查询，刑事侦缉警长123号 Ma Siau Ts 自调至该处以来，似乎对捕房员工没有太大用处。他对所参与的案件表现出缺乏兴趣，并且根据我的指示，因未能执行重要命令而被列为违令者，例如除其他事项外，当被命令前往参与对武装劫匪的突袭行动时，未能出现在捕房。因此，“D”分区侦探官已提出建议，将其降职为巡捕并恢复穿制服执勤。

我无法报告刑事侦缉警员135号 Wong Z Toong 自调至杨树浦捕房以来的工作令人满意。他来到捕房后未破获任何案件，且他在最近一起武装抢劫案中的行为十分可疑，目前正对此进行调查。

您忠实的，
[签名]
分区侦探官，
“D”分区。

D. O.
(“D”分区)。

（批注：T. C. Givis!
已转发；请问我是否应该处理
怀疑是否可能对刑事侦缉警员135号采取任何纪律行动，在这种情况下，可能会建议其转回制服部门。
代理分区
分区官 (“D”) 分区
1931年1月）
